-%.description: Mark dataless files with a % in long listings

-,.description: Group size digits by thousands in long listings

--color.description: Colorize output: always, auto or never

-@.description: Show extended attribute keys and sizes in long listings

-B.description: Print non-printable characters as \xxx octal escapes

-C.description: Arrange entries in columns, sorted down

-D.description: Format dates in long listings with a strftime pattern

-F.description: Append a type indicator such as / * @ = | to each name

-H.description: Follow symbolic links given on the command line

-I.description: Do not imply -A when running as the superuser

-L.description: Follow every symbolic link and list its target

-O.description: Show file flags in long listings

-P.description: List symbolic links themselves rather than their targets

-T.description: Show complete time detail, including seconds and year

-U.description: Use the creation time for sorting and display

-X.description: Do not descend into directories on other file systems

-a.description: Include entries whose names begin with a dot

-b.description: Print non-printable characters as C-style escapes

-c.description: Use the status change time for sorting and display

-d.description: List directories themselves, not their contents

-e.description: Show the ACL after each entry in long listings

-f.description: List entries in directory order without sorting

-g.description: Long listing showing the group but not the owner

-k.description: Report block usage in kilobytes with -s

-m.description: Stream entries across the page, separated by commas

-n.description: Show numeric user and group ids in long listings

-o.description: Long listing showing the owner but not the group

-p.description: Append a slash to directory names

-s.description: Show the number of blocks used by each file

-t.description: Sort by modification time, newest first

-u.description: Use the last access time for sorting and display

-w.description: Print non-printable characters raw, as when not on a terminal

-x.description: Arrange entries in columns, sorted across

-y.description: Sort names in the same direction as times under -t
